description_expanded: ⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: Wooden beams and framing have been installed on the balconies as part of preparations for future community projects. These structures partially reduce the views from the balconies, including the pool area.30A ESCAPES presents… “The Pointe Unit 342,” a stylish 4th floor condo in Rosemary Beach. This 2-bedroom retreat features two private balconies, upscale interiors, and resort-style amenities—all just a 5-min walk to beach access and town center. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location: 5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach Town CenterTwo Private Balconies: Ideal for morning coffee or evening cocktailsSpacious Layout: Open concept kitchen, living, and dining areasUpscale Kitchen: Quartz counters, stainless appliances, island seating for 4Two Comfortable Bedrooms with spa-inspired bathroomsResort Amenities: Pool, hot tub, fire pits, grills, and fitness centerOn-Site Dining: 'Big Bad Breakfast' for Southern-style breakfast and lunchBikes Included: 2 adult bikes for exploring 30A*** LIVING AREAS ***Relax and recharge in this open-concept living space featuring a flat screen TV and elegant coastal furnishings. The layout offers direct access to two private balconies for a seamless indoor-outdoor experience.Open-concept living and dining areaFlat screen TVComfortable, coastal-inspired furnishingsAccess to two private balconies*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***This sleek and functional kitchen is perfect for cooking or gathering, featuring stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and a spacious island with seating for 4. Step outside to enjoy meals al fresco—one of the balconies includes a dining table with seating for 4.Full-size kitchen with stainless steel appliancesQuartz countertops and ample cabinetryIsland with seating for 4Balcony dining table with seating for 4—ideal for outdoor meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Enjoy two private balconies—perfect for relaxing in the sunshine, dining al fresco, or unwinding with a drink in the coastal breeze. These outdoor spaces extend your living area for added comfort and versatility.Two private balconies with lounge seating and diningResort-style pool and oversized hot tubGas grills, fire pits, and shaded lounge areasOn-site restaurant ‘Big Bad Breakfast’*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary Suite: King-size bed, flat screen TV, En-suite with soaking tub, walk-in shower, dual vanities and private balcony accessQueen Guest Suite: Queen-size bed, En-suite bathroom with walk-in shower and dual vanities*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located near Rosemary and Inlet Beach, this condo places you at the heart of 30A’s most desirable attractions. Spend your days exploring boutique shops and dining at 30Avenue, wandering the charming streets of Rosemary Beach, or adventuring through the natural beauty of Camp Helen State Park, where hiking trails and coastal dune lakes await.5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach Town Center5-minute walk to Winston Lane Public Beach AccessSteps to ‘Big Bad Breakfast’ and other local favorites2-minute bike ride to 30Avenue—shopping, dining, and seasonal events10-minute drive to Camp Helen State Park—hiking, paddling, and natural beauty*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes.
